Element.attribute:
An approach to develop a plan detailing the timing for realization of portfolio/program benefits as well as defining and implementing a process to track and monitor expected benefits achievement against that plan including close when benefits have been fully realized. This capability is intended to help you build a schedule for realization of expected benefits and develop a set of procedures and tools to help you track and monitor how the expected benefits are realized against that plan.

The business case is analyzed to determine how benefits will be realized throughout the project time horizon and by key milestones. The capability describes how to define and structure key activities, capture the timing for each of these activities, assign roles and responsibilities for realizing of each benefit.

The tracking tool and data governance plan helps us to establish a replicable benefits realization process. Further, the data governance puts down decision rights and a process for key personnel to access data and create timely reports. It is imperative that the tracking tool contains all the critical value driver metrics, which will drive the benefits to realization.

As the project moves into implementation a proper tracking and reporting should be performed to provide accurate, current and informative benefit updates to key program stakeholders and undertake corrective actions when required.

At the project closure stage benefits realization activities will be transitioned to the business operations. At this stage it is important to identify who will take ownership for any remaining actions needs to ensure the complete realization of the benefits.
Key interdependencies, dis-benefits and assumptions should also be identified and documented.
To develop a plan detailing the timing for realization of benefits and track and monitor expected benefits achievement against those target values.
